name: PRNU tampering map
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Which area of an image from the reference camera lacks its sensor fingerprint?
detection.cameras: 2 simulated sensors, PRNU std 0.005, 384x512; reference from 15 flat images at JPEG 95
detection.positives: 40 images, each altered two ways in a third of each side (see true_positive_rate_by_condition), JPEG 85-95
detection.detected_means: an outlined area covers at least 30% of the altered rectangle (128-px windows)

known_failure_modes: Needs a camera reference built from images of the same camera at the same resolution, and the whole image must match it (PCE above 60).
Areas smaller than about one window (128 px) are missed; dark, saturated and flat areas cannot be decided.
Simulated sensors follow the classical PRNU model; phones' multi-frame processing can weaken it locally.
Resizing, rotation by other than 90 degrees, or strong compression after editing defeat it.
